webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Discord incoming webhook URL, from a channel's Integrations settings page. Must be an https://discord.com/api/webhooks/... URL (discordapp.com, ptb.discord.com and canary.discord.com are also accepted).
webhookUrl.invalid: Enter a Discord webhook URL such as https://discord.com/api/webhooks/<id>/<token> (discordapp.com, ptb.discord.com or canary.discord.com), without embedded credentials or a port

username.title: Username override
username.description: Overrides the default username the webhook posts as in Discord. Leave empty to use the webhook's default.

minSeverity.title: Minimum severity
minSeverity.description: Only notifications at or above this severity are forwarded.

config.edited: Discord webhook settings have been updated
config.notEdited: Failed to update Discord webhook settings

texts.aboutDiscordSettings: Forward system notifications to a Discord channel as a rich embed, using a Discord incoming webhook. In Discord, open the target channel's Integrations settings and create (or copy) a webhook URL.
